summary: A 398-unit, two-phase affordable housing development at 1290 3rd St on Mission Bay South Block 4-East, bounded by Mission Rock, Third and China Basin Streets, being developed by Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services (as Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.) with OCII under an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement. Phase I (165 units, ~160 ft) is on the southern half of the block, facing China Basin St; Phase II (233 units, ~225 ft) is on the northern half, facing Mission Rock St.

milestones.text: OCII issues a Request for Qualifications for a developer team for Block 4-East.

Four development teams respond to OCII's RFQ; a selection panel picks Curtis Development / Bayview Senior Services, with Y.A. studio as lead architect and The John Stewart Company as property manager.
OCII Commission Resolution No. 30-2024 authorizes an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement and a predevelopment loan not to exceed $5,111,731 to Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P.

OCII Commission Resolution No. 02-2026 authorizes commitment of approximately $89,600,000 in permanent gap loan funds for Phase I (165 units); the concurrent Resolution No. 03-2026 authorizes a separate $5,000,000 Phase I predevelopment loan agreement. A related Resolution No. 04-2026 covers a Phase II predevelopment loan (not independently detailed here).
Tentative Parcel Map No. 12743 subdivides Assessor Block 8711, Lot 029B into two lots for Phase I and Phase II.
SF Public Works Order No. 212730 approves the Block 4-East parcel subdivision; the appeal period closes 2026-04-12 with no appeals filed.

A CEQA Notice of Exemption is filed for the Block 4-East project (statutory exemption under AB 1449 / Public Resources Code section 21080.40, the 100%-affordable-housing exemption). All residential units are restricted to 70% AMI or below (excluding 4 manager units).
Phase I construction start targeted (per the developer's own project site; not yet confirmed by an OCII resolution or staff report).
Phase II construction start targeted (per the developer's own project site; not yet confirmed by an OCII resolution or staff report).

open_questions: Affordability figures differ across sources: the April 2026 CEQA Notice of Exemption (the most recent, legally binding source) restricts all 394 residential units to 70% AMI or below; the 2024 ENA staff memo cited 30-80% AMI; the developer's own project site (mb4e.com) still advertises 35% to ~95% AMI. The NOE is treated as authoritative here.

Construction start dates (Phase I early 2027, Phase II 2028) and completion targets (Phase I leasing 2029, Phase II completion ~2030) are sourced only to the developer's own project site, not yet confirmed by an OCII resolution or staff report -- flagged as expected/approximate.
OCII Resolution No. 04-2026 (Phase II predevelopment loan) is referenced in the Feb 2026 resolutions' recitals but was not independently read in this pass; its terms are not detailed here.
No public official's or community group's stated position on this project has been found and sourced.

Whether the site is currently a surface parking lot, and whether the project is administratively separate from the Giants/Tishman Speyer Mission Rock masterplan, are not stated in any cited document: the parking lot is the owner's on-site observation (2026-09-13), and the record no longer asserts either in its summary.

The Spring 2026 SF development forecast (media.api.sf.gov/documents/Spring_2026_DEV_Forecast.pdf) returned 403 on 2026-09-29; the construction start dates rest on the developer's own site (mb4e.com: Phase I Q1 2027, Phase II Q1 2028, pending financing).
